hypothesis: State-conditional momentum — momentum strength is a function of information-diffusion speed (Hong-Stein 1999). In low-vol / high-liquidity / low-dispersion stocks information diffuses slowly & cleanly, so underreaction persists and momentum is stronger with less reversal. CONDMOM conditions cross-sectional momentum on a stock-level stability/diffusion STATE index. Distinct from STR_1715 M08 residual-mom marginal and its market-regime overlay.

interaction_beats_marginal_test.verdict: FAIL — interaction does NOT beat best single marginal NOR sum-of-marginals at the signal/ICIR level. The additive MOM+STATE (sum of marginals) is materially superior (ICIR 0.197, IC_t 3.06). Per QMJ lesson, the conditioning/interaction structure is meaningless: the value is in the linear combination, not the interaction.

Central test interaction_beats_marginal=FALSE — the conditioning structure adds nothing over a simple linear MOM+STATE combination (which itself is a modest IC_t=3.06 additive signal, not novel). Mechanism (Hong-Stein diffusion) is directionally confirmed but quantitatively too weak. recent36 ICIR inverted (-0.137) + subperiod 0.33 + Harvey-t 0.12 all fail graduation. High return cor vs 1715 (0.876) means low DPL-feature incremental value. Honest finding (AX-000): state-conditioning of momentum is not a meaningful KR alpha source; the marginal factors combine additively, not interactively.
